notes: First run with white flag — default to go.
First run with black flag — default to delay (no alternate).
Prior go/green and current green — no transition.
Green to red without alternate — escalate to delay.
Yellow to black with alternate task available — switch to alternate.
Red de-escalating to green — return to go.
Alternate state cleared when flag drops to white.
Already delayed at red with no flag change — hold delay.
